scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a grandchild, doctor or police officer says a relative caused an accident and needs cash for a settlement or surgery; a colleague will come to collect it.
scams.legit_en: The police and hospitals never collect cash from relatives at the door.
bait_tactics: Povedať, že nepočuje dobre, a poprosiť, nech zopakuje, kde sa to stalo
Opýtať sa, v ktorej nemocnici leží

HU.name: Hungary
HU.prevalence_note: Police and MNB (KiberPajzs) warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security staff moving money to a 'security account' with remote access apps, fake police secret investigations, and the grandchild method.

scams.name: Hamis banki biztonsági munkatárs: biztonsági számla
scams.name_en: Fake bank security moving money to a security account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department or the central bank reports a suspicious transfer and asks for netbank login details, an SMS code, remote access or a transfer to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for netbank passwords or codes by phone and never move customers' money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Mondani, hogy a banki alkalmazás még töltődik, és kérni, hogy magyarázza el újra lassan
Megkérdezni, melyik napon és mekkora összegről van szó

scams.name: Hamis rendőr: titkos nyomozás és rendőrségi számla
scams.name_en: Fake police secret investigation
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police investigator says a corrupt bank employee is stealing money, asks for secrecy and tells the owner to withdraw cash or move it to a police account.
scams.legit_en: The Hungarian police never ask citizens to withdraw cash, move money or keep an investigation secret from their bank.
bait_tactics: Mondani, hogy le kell ülnie, és megkérni, hogy ismételje el lassan
Megkérdezni, mióta tart ez az egész

scams.name: Unokázós csalás: baleset, egy ismerős jön a pénzért
scams.name_en: Grandchild method, an acquaintance comes for the money
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a grandchild, lawyer or police officer says a relative caused an accident and needs cash for bail or damages; an acquaintance will come to collect it.
scams.legit_en: The police and courts never collect bail or damages in cash at the door.
bait_tactics: Mondani, hogy rosszul hall, és megkérni, hogy mondja el újra, hol történt
Megkérdezni, melyik kórházban van

BG.name: Bulgaria
BG.prevalence_note: MVR warnings 2025-2026: fake police 'special operations' asking older people to throw or hand over money, relative-accident calls with fake doctors, fake bank security staff, and investment call centres.

scams.name: Фалшива полиция: специализирана акция срещу измамници
scams.name_en: Fake police special operation against fraudsters
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer says an operation to catch fraudsters is under way and asks the owner to throw money from the balcony, leave an envelope or hand cash to an officer.
scams.legit_en: The Bulgarian police never ask citizens to hand over or throw money to help with an operation.
bait_tactics: Да каже, че трябва да си намери очилата, и да помоли да повтори бавно
Да попита от кое управление се обаждат

scams.name: Роднина в катастрофа: пари за операция
scams.name_en: Relative in an accident, money for surgery
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a doctor, relative or police officer says a relative was in a serious accident and needs cash for surgery or bail, to be handed to someone at the entrance.
scams.legit_en: Hospitals and the police never collect cash from relatives at the door.
bait_tactics: Да каже, че не чува добре, и да помоли да повтори в коя болница е
Да попита как се казва лекарят

scams.name: Фалшив банков служител: защитена сметка
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff moving money to a protected account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer or a loan attempt and asks for the SMS code, a remote access app or a transfer to a protected account.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for SMS codes by phone and never move customers' money to another account.
bait_tactics: Да каже, че приложението на банката се обновява, и да помоли да обясни пак
Да попита за каква сума става дума

scams.name: Инвестиционен кол център: гарантирана печалба
scams.name_en: Investment call centre with guaranteed profit
scams.signals_en: A caller from an investment platform promises guaranteed monthly profit, asks to install a remote access app and later demands a profit tax paid in advance to release the money.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never promise guaranteed profit or ask for taxes in advance to pay out.
bait_tactics: Да каже, че си записва, и да попита колко е първата вноска
Да попита колко време отнема изплащането

GR.name: Greece
GR.prevalence_note: Hellenic Police warnings 2025-2026: fake accountants promising allowances, fake police and electricity technicians collecting valuables, relative-accident calls, and fake bank security asking for codes.

scams.name: Ψεύτικος λογιστής: κρατικό επίδομα
scams.name_en: Fake accountant promising a state allowance
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as an accountant or tax office says the owner is entitled to an allowance or tax refund and asks for e-banking codes, the OTP or to gather cash and jewellery for a record.
scams.legit_en: Accountants and the tax office never ask for e-banking codes or OTPs and never record cash or jewellery at home.
bait_tactics: Να πει ότι ψάχνει τα γυαλιά του και να ζητήσει να του τα ξαναπεί αργά
Να ρωτήσει ήρεμα για ποιο επίδομα πρόκειται και πόσα χρήματα είναι

scams.name: Ψεύτικοι αστυνομικοί: φύλαξη τιμαλφών
scams.name_en: Fake police collecting valuables for safekeeping
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer speaks of a criminal investigation and asks the owner to hand over money and valuables for safekeeping or leave jewellery at a given spot.
scams.legit_en: The police never collect money or valuables from citizens for safekeeping.
bait_tactics: Να πει ότι πρέπει να καθίσει και να ζητήσει να του τα εξηγήσει πάλι
Να ρωτήσει από ποιο τμήμα τηλεφωνούν

scams.name: Συγγενής σε τροχαίο: μετρητά για χειρουργείο
scams.name_en: Relative in a traffic accident, cash for surgery
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a doctor or relative says a family member was in an accident and needs cash at once for surgery; a colleague will come to collect it.
scams.legit_en: Hospitals never collect cash from relatives at the door before treatment.
bait_tactics: Να πει ότι δεν ακούει καλά και να ζητήσει να επαναλάβει σε ποιο νοσοκομείο
Να ρωτήσει πώς λέγεται ο γιατρός

scams.name: Ψεύτικος τεχνικός ρεύματος: διαρροή και τιμαλφή
scams.name_en: Fake electricity technician and valuables
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as an electricity network technician warns of a dangerous leak and asks the owner to take out cash and jewellery, wrap them in foil and leave them at the door.
scams.legit_en: Electricity companies never ask customers to move or hand over valuables.
bait_tactics: Να πει ότι ο πίνακας είναι στο υπόγειο και να ρωτήσει τι ακριβώς να κοιτάξει
Να ρωτήσει πότε θα έρθει ο τεχνικός

scams.name: Ψεύτικο τμήμα ασφαλείας τράπεζας: κωδικός επιβεβαίωσης
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for a confirmation code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transaction and asks for the six-digit confirmation code or to approve a notification in the bank app.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for confirmation codes or approvals by phone to cancel a transaction.
bait_tactics: Να πει ότι η εφαρμογή της τράπεζας ενημερώνεται και να ζητήσει να του το εξηγήσει πάλι
Να ρωτήσει για ποιο ποσό είναι η συναλλαγή

HR.name: Croatia
HR.prevalence_note: Croatian police warnings 2025-2026: fake police checking banknotes, fake doctors after an accident, crypto brokers with remote access, and fake bank security asking for m-token codes.

scams.name: Lažni policajci: provjera novčanica
scams.name_en: Fake police checking banknotes
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer says counterfeit banknotes are in circulation and asks the owner to withdraw savings and hand banknotes to an officer in plain clothes for checking.
scams.legit_en: The Croatian police never collect money from citizens to check banknotes.
bait_tactics: Reći da mora sjesti i zamoliti da ponovi polako
Pitati iz koje postaje zovu

scams.name: Lažni liječnik: nesreća i hitna operacija
scams.name_en: Fake doctor after an accident
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a hospital doctor says a relative was badly hurt in an accident and asks for cash or gold for urgent surgery; someone will come to collect it.
scams.legit_en: Hospitals never ask relatives for cash or gold before treatment.
bait_tactics: Reći da ne čuje dobro i zamoliti da ponovi u kojoj je bolnici
Pitati kako se zove liječnik

scams.name: Lažni broker: kriptovalute i AnyDesk
scams.name_en: Fake crypto broker with remote access
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a financial adviser promises crypto profits, asks to install a remote access app and approve payments with the m-token, then demands tax and commission before paying out.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never ask clients to install remote access apps or pay commission before paying out.
bait_tactics: Reći da si to zapisuje i pitati koliko je prva uplata
Pitati koliko traje isplata

scams.name: Lažna sigurnosna služba banke: kod m-tokena
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for m-token codes
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service says the m-banking app expires or a transaction is suspicious and asks for the code the m-token generates or the PIN on a link.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for m-token codes or PINs by phone.
bait_tactics: Reći da se aplikacija banke ažurira i zamoliti da još jednom objasni
Pitati o kojem iznosu je riječ

RS.name: Serbia
RS.prevalence_note: Serbian police and NBS warnings 2025-2026: fake post parcel fees, fake bank card blocks asking for codes, crypto advisers with remote access, and relatives with a new number.

scams.name: Lažna pošta: plaćanje dostave paketa
scams.name_en: Fake post office parcel fee
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post or a courier says a parcel is held for an incomplete address and asks for card number, CVV and an SMS code on a link to pay the delivery fee.
scams.legit_en: Post offices never ask for card numbers, CVV codes or SMS codes by phone or through a link.
bait_tactics: Reći da traži naočare i pitati odakle je paket
Pitati koliko tačno košta dostava

scams.name: Lažna banka: blokada kartice i jednokratni kod
scams.name_en: Fake bank card block and one-time code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service says the card is blocked or reward points expire and asks for the one-time code, CVC, PIN or a photo of the ID card.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for one-time codes, CVC, PIN or ID photos by phone.
bait_tactics: Reći da se aplikacija banke učitava i zamoliti da ponovi polako
Pitati o kojoj transakciji je reč

scams.name: Lažni investicioni savetnik: kripto i daljinski pristup
scams.name_en: Fake investment adviser with crypto and remote access
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as an investment adviser promises safe earnings, asks to install a remote access app and later demands a payment to unlock the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed advisers never ask for payments to unlock profits or for remote access to a phone.
bait_tactics: Reći da zapisuje i pitati koliko je prva uplata
Pitati koliko traje isplata

scams.name: Rođak sa novim brojem: hitna uplata
scams.name_en: Relative with a new number asking for an urgent payment
scams.signals_en: A caller or message from a relative with a new number asks for a verification code or an urgent transfer to someone else's account.
scams.legit_en: Relatives who change numbers can be reached on the old one; an urgent transfer to another person's account is the warning sign.
bait_tactics: Reći da je telefon na punjenju i pitati za koji račun je to
Pitati koliko tačno treba

BA.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
BA.prevalence_note: Police warnings 2025-2026 follow the Serbian pattern: fake parcel fees, fake bank card blocks asking for codes, crypto advisers, and relatives with a new number.

scams.name: Lažna pošta: plaćanje dostave paketa
scams.name_en: Fake post office parcel fee
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post or a courier says a parcel is held for an incomplete address and asks for card number, CVV and an SMS code on a link to pay the delivery fee.
scams.legit_en: Post offices never ask for card numbers, CVV codes or SMS codes by phone or through a link.
bait_tactics: Reći da traži naočare i pitati odakle je paket
Pitati koliko tačno košta dostava

scams.name: Lažna banka: blokada kartice i jednokratni kod
scams.name_en: Fake bank card block and one-time code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service says the card is blocked or reward points expire and asks for the one-time code, CVC, PIN or a photo of the ID card.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for one-time codes, CVC, PIN or ID photos by phone.
bait_tactics: Reći da se aplikacija banke učitava i zamoliti da ponovi polako
Pitati o kojoj transakciji je reč

scams.name: Lažni investicioni savetnik: kripto i daljinski pristup
scams.name_en: Fake investment adviser with crypto and remote access
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as an investment adviser promises safe earnings, asks to install a remote access app and later demands a payment to unlock the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed advisers never ask for payments to unlock profits or for remote access to a phone.
bait_tactics: Reći da zapisuje i pitati koliko je prva uplata
Pitati koliko traje isplata

scams.name: Rođak sa novim brojem: hitna uplata
scams.name_en: Relative with a new number asking for an urgent payment
scams.signals_en: A caller or message from a relative with a new number asks for a verification code or an urgent transfer to someone else's account.
scams.legit_en: Relatives who change numbers can be reached on the old one; an urgent transfer to another person's account is the warning sign.
bait_tactics: Reći da je telefon na punjenju i pitati za koji račun je to
Pitati koliko tačno treba

SI.name: Slovenia
SI.prevalence_note: Slovenian police and SI-CERT warnings 2025-2026: fake crypto exchanges with 'forgotten bitcoins', fake Microsoft support, fake Pošta Slovenije parcel fees and fake bank security asking for passwords.

scams.name: Lažna kripto borza: pozabljeni bitcoini
scams.name_en: Fake crypto exchange with forgotten bitcoins
scams.signals_en: A caller from a crypto exchange says the owner has forgotten bitcoins to pay out and asks for remote access, online banking access, an ID scan or card details.
scams.legit_en: Real exchanges never call about forgotten coins and never ask for online banking access or remote control.
bait_tactics: Reči, da mora poiskati očala, in vprašati, koliko naj bi bilo tega denarja
Vprašati, kdaj naj bi bil račun odprt

scams.name: Lažna Microsoftova tehnična pomoč
scams.name_en: Fake Microsoft technical support
scams.signals_en: A caller from Microsoft support says the computer is infected or the licence has expired and asks to install TeamViewer or similar and give card details.
scams.legit_en: Microsoft never calls users about viruses or licences.
bait_tactics: Reči, da se računalnik zelo počasi prižiga, in vprašati, kaj naj bi videl na zaslonu
Vprašati, katero sporočilo so prejeli

scams.name: Lažna Pošta Slovenije: doplačilo poštnine
scams.name_en: Fake post office parcel fee
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post says a parcel waits for a small extra postage and asks for card details and the CVV through a payment link.
scams.legit_en: Pošta Slovenije never asks for card details or CVV codes by phone or through links in texts.
bait_tactics: Reči, da išče očala, in vprašati, od kod je paket
Vprašati, koliko točno stane

scams.name: Lažna varnostna služba banke: geslo in enkratna koda
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for password and code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service reports a suspicious payment or a blocked account and asks for the online banking password, the SMS code or to confirm a transaction.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for online banking passwords or SMS codes by phone.
bait_tactics: Reči, da se aplikacija banke posodablja, in prositi, naj še enkrat razloži
Vprašati, za kateri znesek gre

MK.name: North Macedonia
MK.prevalence_note: MVR warnings 2025-2026: fake doctors after a traffic accident collecting cash, fake central bank staff asking for card data, fake post parcel fees, and crypto trading platforms.

scams.name: Лажен доктор: сообраќајна несреќа и пари во готово
scams.name_en: Fake doctor after a traffic accident
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a doctor says a relative was in a traffic accident and needs cash for implants or surgery; a man will come to the building to collect it.
scams.legit_en: Hospitals never collect cash from relatives in front of their building.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека не слуша добро и да побара да повтори во која болница е
Да праша како се вика докторот

scams.name: Лажна Народна банка: податоци од картичка
scams.name_en: Fake central bank asking for card data
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the central bank or a bank says the account is at risk and asks for the card number, PIN, the SMS security code or the personal ID number.
scams.legit_en: The central bank and banks never ask for card numbers, PINs or SMS codes by phone.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека апликацијата се ажурира и да побара да објасни уште еднаш
Да праша за која сума станува збор

scams.name: Лажна пошта: наплата за испорака
scams.name_en: Fake post office delivery fee
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post says a parcel has a wrong address and asks to pay a delivery fee through a link with card data and CVV.
scams.legit_en: The post never asks for card data or CVV through links or by phone.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека ги бара очилата и да праша од каде е пакетот
Да праша колку точно чини

scams.name: Крипто платформа: брза заработка
scams.name_en: Crypto trading platform with quick earnings
scams.signals_en: A caller from an investment platform promises quick crypto earnings, asks to install AnyDesk and send an ID photo, then demands a commission before paying out.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never ask for remote access or commissions before paying out.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека запишува и да праша колку е првата уплата
Да праша колку трае исплатата

AL.name: Albania
AL.prevalence_note: Police and Bank of Albania warnings 2025-2026: fake parcel fees, fake bank data checks asking for OTP codes, fake traffic fines, and investment call centres.
AL.cross_border_note: Many investment call centres operate from the region and call abroad as well.

scams.name: Postë e rreme: pagesë për pakon
scams.name_en: Fake post office parcel fee

red_flag_keywords.text: numri i kartës dhe kodi cvv

scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post or a courier says a parcel has a wrong address and asks to confirm it through a link and pay a fee with card number and CVV.
scams.legit_en: The post never asks for card numbers or CVV codes by phone or through links.
bait_tactics: Të thotë se po kërkon syzet dhe të pyesë nga vjen pakoja
Të pyesë sa kushton saktësisht

scams.name: Bankë e rreme: verifikim i të dhënave
scams.name_en: Fake bank data verification
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank says the card or account will be blocked unless data are updated and asks for the OTP code, the e-banking password or the card PIN.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for OTP codes, e-banking passwords or PINs by phone.
bait_tactics: Të thotë se aplikacioni i bankës po përditësohet dhe të kërkojë ta shpjegojë sërish
Të pyesë për çfarë shume bëhet fjalë

scams.name: Policia e rreme: gjobë trafiku
scams.name_en: Fake police traffic fine

red_flag_keywords.text: të dhënat e kartës në telefon

scams.signals_en: A caller or text posing as the police says there is an unpaid traffic fine and asks to pay through a link or give card details on the phone.
scams.legit_en: The police never collect fines through links or card details given by phone.
bait_tactics: Të thotë se po kërkon dokumentet e makinës dhe të pyesë kur ka ndodhur
Të pyesë për cilën rrugë bëhet fjalë

scams.name: Qendër thirrjesh investimi: fitim i garantuar
scams.name_en: Investment call centre with guaranteed profit
scams.signals_en: A caller from a trading platform promises guaranteed profit, asks for a first deposit and AnyDesk, then demands a tax to withdraw the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never promise guaranteed profit or ask for a tax before paying out.
bait_tactics: Të thotë se po i shkruan dhe të pyesë sa është depozita e parë
Të pyesë sa kohë zgjat tërheqja

SE.name: Sweden
SE.prevalence_note: Polisen and PTS warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for Mobilt BankID or bankdosa codes, fake police collecting cards and jewellery, telecom contract tricks signed with BankID, and investment scams.

scams.name: Falsk säkerhetsavdelning: BankID och bankdosa
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for BankID or bankdosa codes
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department warns of a loan or card payment the owner did not make and asks to sign in with Mobilt BankID, read codes from the bankdosa or move money to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Swedish banks never call and ask customers to sign in with BankID, read bankdosa codes or move money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Säga att mobilen just startar om och be dem förklara en gång till, lugnt
Fråga vilken dag lånet ska ha tagits och på hur mycket

scams.name: Falska poliser hämtar kort och smycken
scams.name_en: Fake police collecting bank cards and jewellery
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer says burglars or identity thieves target the owner, asks for BankID verification and says plain-clothes staff will come to collect bank cards, codes, gold and jewellery.
scams.legit_en: The Swedish police never ask people to verify themselves with BankID by phone or collect cards, codes or valuables at home.
bait_tactics: Säga att nycklarna till skåpet ligger hos grannen och fråga när de tänkte komma
Fråga lugnt hur personen som kommer ser ut

scams.name: Falsk mobiloperatör: signera med BankID direkt
scams.name_en: Fake mobile operator pushing a BankID signature
scams.signals_en: A caller from a mobile operator promises a lower monthly cost or a network update and pushes the owner to sign a contract with BankID at once or lose the number today.
scams.legit_en: Operators do not shut numbers off the same day and never require a BankID signature during a cold call.
bait_tactics: Säga att glasögonen ligger i bilen och be dem läsa upp villkoren igen
Fråga vad det kostar efter första året

scams.name: Investeringsbedrägeri med krypto
scams.name_en: Crypto investment scam

red_flag_keywords.text: avgift för att få ut vinsten

scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a financial adviser promises returns on crypto, asks to install a remote-control program and later demands a tax or fee to pay out the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed advisers never ask clients to install remote-control programs or pay a fee to get their profit out.
bait_tactics: Säga att man skriver upp allt och fråga hur mycket man ska börja med
Fråga hur lång tid en utbetalning tar

NO.name: Norway
NO.prevalence_note: Politiet and Økokrim warnings 2025-2026: fake bank or police staff asking for BankID passwords and one-time codes (the 'Olga' method), fake Microsoft support, fake Skatteetaten refunds and investment scams.

scams.name: BankID-svindel: falsk bank eller politi
scams.name_en: BankID fraud by fake bank or police staff
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department, the police or Økokrim speaks of a suspicious loan and asks for the BankID password and one-time code, an approval in the BankID app or a transfer to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Banks and the police never ask for BankID passwords or codes and never move money to a safe account.
bait_tactics: Si at telefonen holder på å starte på nytt og be dem forklare en gang til, rolig
Spørre hvilken dag lånet skal være tatt opp og hvor mye

scams.name: Falsk Microsoft-support: fjerntilgang
scams.name_en: Fake Microsoft support with remote access
scams.signals_en: A caller from Microsoft or an IT company says the computer has a virus or a licence problem and asks for remote access and to log in to online banking while they watch.
scams.legit_en: Microsoft never calls about viruses or licences and never asks to watch online banking.
bait_tactics: Si at PC-en starter veldig sakte og spørre hva som skal stå på skjermen
Spørre hvilken feilmelding de har fått

scams.name: Falsk Skatteetaten: penger til gode
scams.name_en: Fake tax office refund
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from Skatteetaten says the owner has money back and asks to click a link and confirm with BankID or give card number and security code for the payout.
scams.legit_en: Skatteetaten pays refunds to the registered account and never asks for card numbers or codes.
bait_tactics: Si at brillene ligger i bilen og spørre hvor mye det gjelder
Spørre hvilket år oppgjøret gjelder

scams.name: Investeringssvindel med krypto
scams.name_en: Crypto investment scam
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a broker promises guaranteed returns on crypto or shares, asks for a starting deposit and remote access, then demands a fee to pay out the gain.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never promise guaranteed returns or charge fees to release a gain.
bait_tactics: Si at man skriver ned alt og spørre hvor mye man må begynne med
Spørre hvor lang tid en utbetaling tar

DK.name: Denmark
DK.prevalence_note: Politiet and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for MitID approvals or a move to a security account, fake police or tax staff asking for card details, and fake technical support.

scams.name: Falsk bankrådgiver: godkend med MitID
scams.name_en: Fake bank adviser asking for a MitID approval
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer and asks the owner to approve in MitID, give a code or move money to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Danish banks never ask customers to approve MitID requests they did not start or to move money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Sige at telefonen genstarter og bede dem forklare det en gang til, roligt
Spørge hvilken dag overførslen var og hvor stort beløbet var

scams.name: Falsk politi eller Skattestyrelsen: identitetsmisbrug
scams.name_en: Fake police or tax office about identity misuse
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the police or the tax agency speaks of identity misuse or an investigation and asks for card details, the CPR number and a MitID approval.
scams.legit_en: The police and Skattestyrelsen never ask for card details or MitID approvals by phone.
bait_tactics: Sige at man lige skal finde brillerne og bede dem gentage det langsomt
Spørge hvornår misbruget skulle være sket

scams.name: Falsk teknisk support: overtage kontrollen
scams.name_en: Fake tech support taking control of the computer
scams.signals_en: A caller from a technical department says the computer has a security problem and asks to download a program so they can take control, then to log in to online banking.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about security problems and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Sige at computeren starter meget langsomt og spørge hvad der skal stå på skærmen
Spørge hvilken fejlbesked de har fået

FI.name: Finland
FI.prevalence_note: Poliisi and Traficom warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for bank credentials and moving money to a 'safe account', fake police or tax staff asking for online bank codes, and fake technical support.

scams.name: Valepankkivirkailija: pankkitunnukset ja turvatili
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff asking for credentials and a safe account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer and asks for bank credentials, a confirmation code or a move of money to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Finnish banks never ask for bank credentials or codes by phone and never move money to a safe account.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että pankin sovellus päivittyy, ja pyytää selittämään uudestaan rauhassa
Kysyä, minä päivänä siirto tehtiin ja kuinka suuri summa

scams.name: Valepoliisi tai -viranomainen: identiteettivarkaus
scams.name_en: Fake police or authority about identity theft
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the police, the tax office or Traficom speaks of identity theft or a criminal case and asks for online bank codes, card details or a password.
scams.legit_en: The police and other authorities never ask for online bank codes, card details or passwords by phone.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että pitää etsiä silmälasit, ja pyytää toistamaan hitaasti
Kysyä, milloin varkauden piti tapahtua

scams.name: Vale tekninen tuki: etähallintaohjelma
scams.name_en: Fake tech support with a remote-control program
scams.signals_en: A caller from technical support says the computer has a virus or a licence problem and asks to install a remote-control program and enter credit card details.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses or licences and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että tietokone käynnistyy hitaasti, ja kysyä, mitä ruudulla pitäisi näkyä
Kysyä, minkä virheilmoituksen he saivat

IS.name: Iceland
IS.prevalence_note: Lögreglan and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake bank staff asking for an approval in rafræn skilríki or the Auðkenni app, fake technical support with AnyDesk, and crypto investment calls.
IS.cross_border_note: Many of these calls come from abroad in English.

scams.name: Falskur bankastarfsmaður: samþykkja rafræn skilríki
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff asking to approve an e-ID request
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports an unusual payment and asks the owner to approve a request in rafræn skilríki or the Auðkenni app or give a security number.
scams.legit_en: Icelandic banks never ask customers to approve an e-ID request they did not start or to give security numbers.
bait_tactics: Segja að síminn sé að endurræsa sig og biðja þá að útskýra aftur í rólegheitum
Spyrja hvaða dag greiðslan var og hversu há

scams.name: Fölsk tækniþjónusta: setja upp forrit
scams.name_en: Fake tech support installing a program
scams.signals_en: A caller from technical support says the computer has a problem or offers a refund and asks to install AnyDesk or a similar program and enter card details.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about refunds or viruses and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Segja að tölvan sé mjög lengi að ræsa sig og spyrja hvað eigi að sjást á skjánum
Spyrja hvaða villuboð þeir fengu

scams.name: Rafmyntasvik: óinnleyst inneign
scams.name_en: Crypto investment with unclaimed balance
scams.signals_en: A caller says the owner has an unclaimed crypto balance or a profitable investment and asks for card details or to log in to online banking to receive it.
scams.legit_en: No real exchange calls about unclaimed balances or asks for online banking access.
bait_tactics: Segja að maður skrifi allt niður og spyrja hversu há inneignin sé
Spyrja hvenær reikningurinn var stofnaður
